status: predeclared research candidate; no quality qualification implied
automatic_prior: finite Gaussian alpha prior, including endpoints; never a hard constraint
observation_variance: 1/(12*255*255), encoded-byte quantization floor; not camera calibration
color_covariance_floor: same observation variance times identity, per authors' addendum

automatic_color_support.classification: uncertain source-color observations; not user labels or physical opacity

explicit_user_constraints: 0/255 pin alpha and can supply corresponding observed colors;128 releases; benchmark has none

sample_search.population: four-neighbor support boundaries plus image edges
sample_search.distribution: one weighted full-covariance RGB Gaussian per class; bounded approximation to mixture Bayesian matting

joint_solver.method: conditional Gaussian F/B elimination and bounded scalar alpha search
joint_solver.selection_energy: original joint Gaussian objective after gamut clipping, covariance log determinants and finite alpha prior

foreground_output: joint estimate, single encoded-byte quantization; output-alpha endpoints preserve observed RGB exactly, without any reference-opaque claim
missing_class_policy: refuse and preserve original prior/source diagnostics; never certify a translucent composite as foreground

qualification.gates: all original alpha/color/recomposition/opaque gates unchanged; refusals fail
qualification.physical_transmission_reference: not available; bottle annotation is silhouette
